models.label: Genesys PI House (LUA Vision, opencode)
models.notes: Added 2026-09-23 per user. Brazilian Genesys PI family (LUA Vision Tecnologia, Sao Paulo). Flagship: 'maximum quality for long/complex/high-stakes work', 600K ctx / 128K out. OpenAI-compatible /v1, Bearer auth; tools+streaming+json_schema verified. GENERAL model (no coding-specialized variant); regulated-market PT/EN focus. rates_per_m = BRL price / 5.16 (2026-09-23, verified): in 55, cachedIn 6, out 275 BRL/M. CAVEAT: server injects a large system prompt (~741 tok on a bare call) inflating input tokens/cost. Run SHIELDED per shield-all policy.

models.label: Genesys PI Enterprise (LUA Vision, opencode)
models.notes: Added 2026-09-23 per user. Genesys PI 'production workhorse: high quality, low latency', 384K ctx / 128K out. rates_per_m = BRL/5.16: in 4, cachedIn 0.5, out 20 BRL/M. Smoke-tested one sprint first; if too slow or failing too much, drop to house-only (user decision). Run SHIELDED.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude Code)

Claude Code harness, Max sub (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stripped by runner), shielded per shield-all + git-sandbox.
